samples.title: Network-disabled offline region reference
samples.summary: Proves that a persisted IndexedDB region, a durable queued edit, and a bounded host-owned application shell survive reload after browser networking is disabled, then replays that edit exactly once against a loopback fixture transport on reconnect and reports one composed local-first state.

lifecycle.reason: Retain as browser evidence for the disconnected-read, offline edit capture and reconnect replay, and composed local-first state acceptance slices of the experimental offline region contract.

data.provenance: One committed integrity-, length-, and version-pinned fixture served from an isolated loopback origin and persisted through the public IndexedDB offline contract; edit replay is bound to a loopback fixture endpoint that mirrors the documented acknowledgement shape and keeps no replica, upload cursor, or conflict store.
data.freshness: Explicit online observation time and stale disconnected diagnostic time.

samples.expectedDegradation: A missing persisted region renders an explicit offline cache miss and a partial/missing-regions local-first state that a queued edit cannot mask, and a conflicted, mismatched, or retryable acknowledgement leaves durable typed queue state instead of a silent drop; the fixture does not synthesize an empty success and its loopback replay endpoint does not claim replica synchronization or end-to-end exactly-once server semantics.
